item.title: Is Claude Conscious? Inside Anthropic’s Quest to Instill Morality Into Its A.I. Models

item.media:credit: Alessandro Penso for The New York Times
item.media:description: “To be clear,” Christopher Olah told me, “we don’t know if A.I. models are conscious. I don’t know. I’m genuinely uncertain. The thing that I care about is that we get to the right answer, whatever it is.”
